dataset.name: pdf-reader-rag-golden-v1
dataset.description: Hand-labelled corpus and queries for the PDF reader RAG pipeline. Two topic pairs (biology/nutrition, cloud/distributed systems) share concepts so cross-document recommendations have known correct answers. Relevance is labelled at (document, page) granularity, matching what the reader UI navigates to.

gates.why: Recommendations and chat use the hybrid path; the right page should be in the top 3.
The best page should usually be first or second.
Retrieved context must contain the facts the answer needs.
The side panel should surface the related page from another PDF.
The side panel must never show the PDF that is already open.
Side-panel matches should come from related subjects, not unrelated filler.
Page turns refresh the panel; retrieval must stay interactive.
